title: Cheap Fruit esp
features: Shows fruits location easy script to use
script:
local ScreenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
local ToggleButton = Instance.new("TextButton")
local UICorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
local TPButton = Instance.new("TextButton") -- New Teleport Button
local TPCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")

ScreenGui.Name = "FruitESPGui"
ScreenGui.Parent = game:GetService("CoreGui")
ScreenGui.ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling

-- Original ESP Button Configurations
ToggleButton.Name = "ToggleButton"
ToggleButton.Parent = ScreenGui
ToggleButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(170, 0, 0) -- Defaulted to red match state
ToggleButton.Position = UDim2.new(0.05, 0, 0.4, 0)
ToggleButton.Size = UDim2.new(0, 120, 0, 45) -- Resized slightly for mobile alignment
ToggleButton.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
ToggleButton.Text = "Fruit ESP: OFF"
ToggleButton.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
ToggleButton.TextSize = 14.0
ToggleButton.Active = true
ToggleButton.Draggable = true

UICorner.Parent = ToggleButton

-- 🚀 New Teleport Button (Anchored directly under the draggable toggle button)
TPButton.Name = "TPButton"
TPButton.Parent = ToggleButton -- Parenting to ToggleButton ensures it moves with it when dragged
TPButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30, 30, 30)
TPButton.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, 5) -- Aligned perfectly underneath with a 5px gap
TPButton.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 40)
TPButton.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
TPButton.Text = "⚡ Teleport to Fruit"
TPButton.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
TPButton.TextSize = 14.0

TPCorner.Parent = TPButton

local espEnabled = false
local espObjects = {}

local function createEsp(fruit)
    if not fruit:FindFirstChild("FruitESP") then
        local billboard = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
        billboard.Name = "FruitESP"
        billboard.AlwaysOnTop = true
        billboard.Size = UDim2.new(0, 100, 0, 50)
        billboard.Adornee = fruit
        billboard.Parent = fruit

        local textLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
        textLabel.Parent = billboard
        textLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        textLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
        textLabel.Text = fruit.Name
        textLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 0)
        textLabel.TextStrokeTransparency = 0
        textLabel.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
        textLabel.TextSize = 16

        table.insert(espObjects, billboard)
    end
end

local function removeEsp()
    for _, obj in pairs(espObjects) do
        if obj then obj:Destroy() end
    end
    espObjects = {}
end

local function updateEsp()
    removeEsp()
    if espEnabled then
        for _, v in pairs(game.Workspace:GetChildren()) do
            if v.Name:find("Fruit") or (v:IsA("Tool") and v.Name:find("Fruit")) then
                createEsp(v)
            end
        end
    end
end

-- Teleport Logic Function
local function teleportToClosestFruit()
    local player = game.Players.LocalPlayer
    local character = player.Character
    if not character or not character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then return end
    
    local rootPart = character.HumanoidRootPart
    local targetFruit = nil
    local shortestDistance = math.huge

    -- Scan for valid active map fruits
    for _, v in pairs(game.Workspace:GetChildren()) do
        if v.Name:find("Fruit") or (v:IsA("Tool") and v.Name:find("Fruit")) then
            -- Find physical part/handle to track coordinates
            local targetPart = v:FindFirstChild("Handle") or v:FindFirstChildOfClass("Part") or v:FindFirstChildOfClass("MeshPart")
            if targetPart then
                local distance = (targetPart.Position - rootPart.Position).Magnitude
                if distance < shortestDistance then
                    shortestDistance = distance
                    targetFruit = targetPart
                end
            end
        end
    end

    -- Process Teleportation Vector
    if targetFruit then
        TPButton.Text = "Teleporting..."
        TPButton.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 0)
        
        -- Safe Teleport: Moves your character 3 studs directly above the fruit to prevent clipping
        rootPart.CFrame = targetFruit.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 3, 0)
        
        task.wait(0.5)
        TPButton.Text = "⚡ Teleport to Fruit"
        TPButton.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    else
        -- Feedback UI if no real fruits exist in the workspace cache
        TPButton.Text = "❌ No Fruits Found!"
        TPButton.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 100, 100)
        task.wait(1.5)
        TPButton.Text = "⚡ Teleport to Fruit"
        TPButton.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    end
end

-- Button Listeners
ToggleButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    espEnabled = not espEnabled
    if espEnabled then
        ToggleButton.Text = "Fruit ESP: ON"
        ToggleButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 170, 0)
        updateEsp()
    else
        ToggleButton.Text = "Fruit ESP: OFF"
        ToggleButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(170, 0, 0)
        removeEsp()
    end
end)

TPButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    teleportToClosestFruit()
end)

game.Workspace.ChildAdded:Connect(function(child)
    if espEnabled and (child.Name:find("Fruit") or (child:IsA("Tool") and child.Name:find("Fruit"))) then
        task.wait(0.5)
        createEsp(child)
    end
end)

task.spawn(function()
    while task.wait(5) do
        if espEnabled then
            updateEsp()
        end
    end
end)
